added.text: ^$25/month for your first month with a 12-month or 6-month plan.
After the first month, membership continues for $74/mo for the remainder of the 12-month plan, or $84/mo for the remainder of the 6-month plan.
Plans auto-renew for another 12-month or 6-month period respectively at the same monthly rate at the end of each plan.
